import asyncio, json
from pathlib import Path
import mujoco
from g1_arm_skill import ArmRaiseSkill
from g1_planning import G1PlanningSession, make_observation
from g1_source import activate_source

async def verify():
    source=activate_source()
    from stack_scene import build_model, reset_to_reference_pose
    from safety_governor import manipulator_contact_violations
    model=build_model(); data=mujoco.MjData(model); reset_to_reference_pose(model,data)
    skill=ArmRaiseSkill(model,data,source=source)
    session=G1PlanningSession(Path.cwd(),skill,lambda:make_observation(model,data,skill,scene_revision=0))
    intervention=None
    try:
        session.start("请抬起右臂，保持一秒，然后回到原来的位置。")
        while session.state()["status"]=="planning": await asyncio.sleep(.02)
        assert session.state()["status"]=="ready", session.state()["error"]
        session.execute(session.state()["decision_id"])
        while session.locks_scene:
            if session.state()["status"] in ("executing","stopping"):
                state=skill.state()
                if intervention is None and state["phase"]=="raise" and state["metrics"]["right_elevation_m"]>.02:
                    candidates=[i for i in range(model.ngeom) if "left_dex1" in (mujoco.mj_id2name(model,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_BODY,int(model.geom_bodyid[i])) or "") and (model.geom_contype[i] or model.geom_conaffinity[i])]
                    joint=mujoco.mj_name2id(model,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_JOINT,"red_cube_free")
                    qpos=int(model.jnt_qposadr[joint]); data.qpos[qpos:qpos+3]=data.geom_xpos[candidates[0]]
                    mujoco.mj_forward(model,data)
                    reasons=manipulator_contact_violations(model,data,"free_space")
                    assert "dex_cube_outside_manipulation_phase" in reasons
                    intervention={"kind":"deliberate negative-fixture cube relocation into a real collision-enabled left finger", "at_simulation_s":data.time,"before_injection_skill":state,"actual_contact_reasons":reasons,"provider_double":False,"physics_double":False}
                if skill.active: skill.step()
                session.advance()
                await asyncio.sleep(0)
            else: await asyncio.sleep(.02)
        report=session.report(); report["verification"]={"scope":"Deliberately injected collision; real subscription decisions and real MuJoCo result/feedback, not a normal-task success trial", "intervention":intervention}
        with Path("results/g1_planner_collision_failure.json").open("x",encoding="utf-8") as stream: json.dump(report,stream,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)
        assert intervention is not None
        assert report["status"]=="failed" and report["local_outcome"]=="failed" and not report["success"]
        assert report["execution_result"]["status"]=="failed" and report["assessment"]["outcome"]=="failed"
        assert report["skill_invocations"]==1 and len(report["history"])==2
        print(json.dumps({"status":report["status"],"actual_outcome":report["execution_result"]["status"],"model_feedback":report["assessment"],"reason":report["execution_result"]["reason"],"model_threads":[r["thread_id"] for r in report["history"]]},ensure_ascii=False))
    finally: await session.close()

asyncio.run(verify())
